author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Is Crimson Desert A Perfectly Balanced Game?
A huge thanks to Ubsioft For Sponsoring this video if you want to checkout The Division Resurgence then you can do so via this cool link: https://tdr-wwl.onelink.me/3G20/SpiffingBrit

Welcome back ladies and gents to my favourite open World RPG of 2026, CRIMSON DESERT! This glorious game has been developed by the team at pearly abyss and it is absolutely massive! In the last crimson desert video I showed off some general gameplay and balance issues after I played 100 hours of crimson desert. But now I return with even more hours of gameplay and new bugs, glitches and exploits at my disposal to show off how to properly break this game. I am talking about infinite money, infinite upgrades, infinite arrows and a build that consists of turning our main character kliff into a walking tank or anti aircraft cannon that can fire off more explosive rounds than the entire US military. 


So what is crimson desert well according to steam: Crimson Dese
title: HOW TO BREAK CRIMSON DESERT - A PERFECTLY BALANCED GAME WITH NO EXPLOITS
